description: Full ASCII table 0–127: decimal, hex, octal, character, control-code names and HTML entities — searchable.

faqs.a: The table covers all 128 ASCII codes: 0–31 and 127 are control codes (shown by name), 32–126 are printable characters.
Type a decimal, hex value, character or control name (e.g. 65, 0x41, A, or NUL) to filter the table.
HTML entities like & let you safely write special characters in HTML source.
faqs.q: What are the HTML entity columns for?

faqs.a: Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.

howto: Type in the search box to filter by code, character or name.
Click Copy on any row to copy its decimal code.
title: ASCII Table Reference
